text: The initiative features an integrated tech stack for underwriting-to-claims processes, utilizing remote sensing and IoT for plot and loss area determination, and proactive disaster warning systems. It emphasizes smallholder suitability and promotes industry alliances and government-industry-tech co-governance for scalable deployment. The initiative also aims for full coverage across policy and commercial lines, including planting, breeding, and forestry.
